race.comment: FARFETCHED (1) has been going well in Sydney midweekers this prep without threatening, the latest offering the pick of the runs when beaten 1.5 lengths into third over 1200m at Canterbury. Good weight carrier who is ready to open the account. MARK OF GLORY worked home well but never looked likely when fresh from a spell over 1250m at Newcastle last time out. Draws a nice gate and gets in a little lighter under today's scale. Should be thereabouts. PROMENADE (5) raced handy but lacked the change of gears required when unplaced first-up over 1100m at Warwick Farm. Can play a bigger role today over the extra 200m. CHE OLE (4) continues to race well deep into this prep. Ran third in a strong form race over this trip at Hawkesbury two back - that is a handy form reference. THINKSHE'S AUSBRED (2) caught the eye late on debut over 1100m at Hawkesbury three weeks ago. One to watch for in the dying stages.
